paper_metadata.title: Superior creep resistance in a γ'-strengthened Co-based single-crystal superalloy at 760 °C and 90% yield strength

evidence.quote: In this study, the tensile creep performance of a Co-based SX superalloy was systematically revealed for the first time
In this study, the tensile creep performance of a Co-based SX superalloy was systematically revealed for the first time and found to be distinct from those of Re-containing Ni-based SX superalloys
the superior creep resistance in the early creep stage is ascribed to the prevalent dislocation movements in γ channels and W segregation-assisted γ′ shearing process

phases_and_microstructures.name: W segregation-assisted γ' shearing by leading Shockley partial dislocation

evidence.quote: the superior creep resistance in the early creep stage is ascribed to the prevalent dislocation movements in γ channels and W segregation-assisted γ′ shearing process by the leading Shockley partial dislocation instead of Co and Cr segregation a<112> SF ribbon in Re-containing Ni-based SX superalloys in the accelerating creep stage

phases_and_microstructures.name: W segregation at stacking faults promoting local χ/η phase transformations

evidence.quote: W segregates at SFs and promotes the local χ/η phase transformations, which stabilizes the SF configurations and enhances the SF interactions after the accelerating creep stage
